title: Brain Monster Eclipse
description: A grotesque green monster with an exposed brain for a head, large bulging eyes, and a wide mouth full of teeth stands in a barren cracked landscape. It holds a glowing golden coin emitting purple energy while purple smoke swirls around its tentacle-like lower body, with a blood-red solar eclipse dominating the dark sky behind it.
prompt: A grotesque surreal monster with an exposed brain head, large white eyes and sharp teeth, green and purple veiny body with tentacles, standing in a cracked desert landscape. It holds a glowing golden coin with purple lightning, purple smoke swirling at its base. Dramatic blood red and black solar eclipse in a stormy sky, dark mountains in the distance, ominous and highly detailed dark fantasy style.
